long_biography.plain_text:
Born in Leninakan, now Gyumri, Timchenko trained as an electrical engineer and began at a Leningrad plant that built power equipment. He later moved into Soviet foreign trade and oil-product exports. After working with a Finnish importer of Russian petroleum, he co-founded Gunvor, developing the commodity trader into the enterprise that first produced his fortune.

Timchenko sold his Gunvor stake in 2014 and concentrated his capital through Volga Group. The investment vehicle holds major interests in natural-gas producer Novatek and petrochemical company Sibur, alongside transport, construction and other assets. Energy therefore remains his primary wealth sector. His present relationship to the assets is principally that of an investor.
